Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

300 Spectrum Center Dr., #1200
Irvine, CA 92618

All cables interconnecting the antennas and the ION nodes must be underground and within the pole. The power meter and breaker are to be housed within a power meter pedestal measuring approximately 52â€ x 23â€ x 13â€ and that pedestal must be appropriately screened from view, including by location, color and other camouflage techniques that blend the equipment into the existing environment. Staff shall provide direction to the applicant related to the placement and color of the pedestal; 2) The steel pole shall be burnished prior to painting. The pole and all equipment mounted on it (including without limitation to the antennas, antenna mounting hardware, and cables) must be painted a flat brown, and maintained in the same condition thereafter; 3) Permittee shall place its name on the lid of the proposed underground fiber vault and the recommended base station vault, and on the recommended power meter; 4) Permittee shall install and at all times maintain in good condition an â€œRF Noticeâ€ and â€œNetwork Operations Center Informationâ€ sign on the steel pole at approximately 14 feet AGL; 5) Permittee shall ensure that all RF signage complies with FCC OET Bulletin 65 or ANSI C95.2 for color, symbol, and content conventions; and 6) AC dike curbing shall be installed along the edge of pavement subject to review and approval by the City Engineer.

All cables interconnecting the antennas and the ION nodes must be underground and within the pole. The power meter and breaker are to be housed within a power meter pedestal measuring approximately 52â€ x 23â€ x 13â€ and that pedestal must be appropriately screened from view, including by location, color and other camouflage techniques that blend the equipment into the existing environment. Staff shall provide direction to the applicant related to the placement and color of the pedestal; 2) The steel pole shall be burnished prior to painting. No offset brackets for these elements shall be permitted; 3) Permittee shall install and at all times maintain in good condition an â€œRF Noticeâ€ and â€œNetwork Operations Center Informationâ€ sign on the wood pole at approximately or above 14 feet AGL; and 4) Permittee shall ensure that all RF signage complies with FCC OET Bulletin 65 or ANSI C95.2 for color, symbol, and content conventions.
